_readme: Each entry is one gold-labeled query. gold_chunk_ids = the chunk_id(s) a correct retrieval MUST include. gold_type = 'qa' or 'policy'. 'confidence' notes whether this is an exact match or a reasonable-but-partial one (see notes). Entries here were labeled by reading the actual resolution_text against real retrieved chunk content -- not guessed. See coverage_gaps.md in the same folder for 16 additional real customer queries that currently have NO matching chunk in the knowledge base; those are a data coverage finding, not something to force-label.

queries.query: What are the requirements for a car loan?
I see a transaction I didn't make
How do I check my loan application status?
queries.note: Previously a documented coverage gap (see coverage_gaps.md) — qa_QA009 was only a partial match. Added qa_QA021 specifically to close this gap; this entry now tests the real fix.

queries.query: My salary credit is delayed by 3 days
I'm unable to login to my net banking account
Multiple small transactions from my account I don't recognize
I can't link my Aadhaar due to name mismatch
I can't complete video KYC — the link keeps failing
My account is frozen because of KYC but I submitted documents
I applied for a business loan 3 weeks ago and heard nothing
Why was my loan application rejected?
My company account KYC documents were submitted but account is still restricted
queries.note: Originally labeled qa_QA011 only (partial match, since it's about individual not corporate KYC). Full-corpus check (not just top-5) found kyc_policy_chunk_001 section 2.2, which lists the actual corporate document requirements (board resolution, MCA filings) matching this ticket's resolution -- and this chunk did NOT appear in the original top-5 retrieval. This is a genuine recall miss the top-5-only labeling method couldn't have caught.

queries.query: What is the status of my home loan application #TKT128276?
queries.note: Answers loan timeline, not literally a status-tracking question, but same underlying intent.
